fact: A presentation by the Ministry of ICT and Postal Services' Director for IT at an ITU workshop on 25-29 November 2019 lists the Communication Sector Policy 2013-2018 among South Sudan's ICT policies, a draft review of the South Sudan ICT Policy, and the National Communication Act 2012.
title: South Sudan: E-Applications Development; Policy Strategy
publisher: ITU E-Application Development Workshop for East African Member States (Ministry of ICT and Postal Services, South Sudan)
